caption: The drawing depicts a decorative horizontal border composed of three main sections. The top section features an ornamental pattern in brown and off-white, consisting of repeating rounded and angular shapes with small circular accents. Immediately below this, there is a narrow white band bordered by thin brown lines. The central section is a solid blue rectangular stripe spanning the width of the image. The bottom section consists of a twisted rope-like design, rendered in brown, white, and cream colors. Below the decorative band, in the lower left, the text “M. BANK.” is printed in black capital letters. In the lower right, there is a horizontal scale marked from 0 to 4 inches, divided into 1-inch increments. The background of the drawing is a solid off-white or cream color.
title: Wall Paper Border
